data.narrative:
David Energy, founded by James McGinniss, Brian Maxwell, and Ahmed Salman, is a Series A–stage climate and energy company that has raised $64.4M to date. The valuation comp universe comprises one public company (LNZA) and eight private frontier-tech peers in Climate & Energy, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Valuation triangulation was limited to stage-progression methodology. Using total capital raised ($64.4M) as a proxy baseline and applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier from Series A to subsequent stages yields an implied valuation of $129M. Peer-median analysis was not applicable; while eight same-sector comparables exist, none met minimum thresholds (three or more datapoints) for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier filtering. A broader sector-wide median would risk material distortion given the heterogeneity of frontier-climate businesses and capital intensity variance across subsectors.

The single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $109M (low) to $148M (high), centered at $129M. This range reflects standard Series A progression mechanics but carries significant uncertainty. Key variables not resolved by available data include unit economics, customer concentration, technical validation stage, and capital efficiency relative to the peer set. Additional detail on cash burn rate and runway would substantiate positioning within this range.
